name: @atrium/loop
description: The reference channel-loop daemon (#148): a separate process that authenticates as the agent principal, consumes its channel room's ordered stream, and routes each inbound message into exactly one arm (steer / open-work / answer) with a durable outcome journal. It talks to the server ONLY over the wire protocol — a lint rule (biome noRestrictedImports, scoped to apps/loop) forbids importing apps/server internals.
